errors.evidence: The description uses the term 'Gründungsbarrieren' (barriers to starting a business), which is taken from the figure caption provided as metadata, not from the content of the image itself. The image title only refers to 'all respondents with answer yes (in %)'.

errors.text_span: sondern scheinen der Reihenfolge der Kategorien auf der vertikalen Achse zu folgen
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence is confusing and tautological. It is self-evident that a bar for a specific category is located at the position of that category on the axis. The phrasing is awkward and does not add clarity to the preceding correct statement that the bars are not sorted by value.
